description: The REFUSAL of deleting a block event, the other half of tests/jobs/block-events-delete-reactive.json. Over job:block-events-reactive a second instance WITHOUT a handler is also born, and only then is the delete of IBlockEvent:OnRate attempted. The delete has to be refused and the message has to name the THREE consumers: the ITriggerNode that fires (inside the block), the IEventHandler of the instance that has a handler and the IEventHandler of the instance that does NOT - because the IEventHandler is born with the instance even if empty, and an event without a single handler linked still cannot be deleted. Runs with `python scripts/run_job.py tests/jobs-negative/delete-block-event-in-use.json`: it has to give ok=False (NegativeJobTests.JobFailsWithTheTeachingMessage).
